title: inset-panel — a second surface floating inside the band on all four sides
idea: A panel painted in the opposite surface floats inside the band with a fixed margin on all four sides, so one band carries two surfaces and the inner one holds everything.
why_new: a section is one surface today — full-bleed-cover.md explicitly forbids stacking a panel on the cover. That rule is right for a cover and wrong as a general limit: it leaves the generator no way to build a bounded call to action inside a band.
built_from: a full-aligned outer group on one surface holding one constrained inner group on another. No new CSS, but it needs the cover rule scoped to full-bleed-cover rather than applied everywhere.
risk: the most generic entry on this page. A box on a background is the default shape of every template on the internet, so it earns its place only through a real margin proportion and two surfaces that genuinely differ. It also needs two contrast checks instead of one.
